description: Use this when someone wants mining projects or properties by commodity, country or company: e.g. gold properties in Canada, a company's properties, or properties whose name contains a word. Give it any of a name, a commodity, a country or a company. Returns the properties, newest news first (6ix never ranks them), each with its owner, commodities, country, how many estimates, studies and drill releases 6ix lists, and its 6ix.com page; get_mineral_project gives one property's figures.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

country.description: The country's English name: Canada, United States, Australia…

name: find_mineral_projects
title: Find mineral properties
